notes:
Inbound from marketing: small apparel/electronics shop focusing on curated drops. Interested in hosted API for quick self-serve integration.
- Catalog size: ~12k SKUs, mix of short/long descriptions and attributes, images stored separately.
- Primary MVP: product Q&A (chat-style), then catalog enrichment (attribute extraction, short copy generation) and search relevance tuning.
- Traffic pattern: baseline 10–30 RPS for site search, bursts up to 300–400 RPS during weekend drops — cost sensitivity high.
- Latency target: p95 under 200ms for Q&A queries; willing to accept higher p99 for embeddings jobs run offline.
- Model preference: prefer smaller/quantized open models for cost but want fallback to higher-quality variant for complex queries. Asked about automatic routing by cost/latency.
- Data policy: customer content ok to send to hosted API but must be stored transiently; require DPA + SOC2 evidence; US data residency preferable.
- Quote from founder: "We need something we can ship in a week and not blow the budget on our first sale."
- Implementation notes: frontend will call backend which will call Redwood hosted API; want SDK examples (node, python) and example prompt templates for product Q&A.
- POC success criteria: 1) 80% answer relevance on a 200-sample test, 2) burst handling without 5xxs during simulated drop, 3) cost < $X per 1k queries (tbd).
